**MEMORANDUM OF ASSOCIATION OF SUNRISE RESIDENCY WELFARE ASSOCIATION**

**1. NAME OF THE SOCIETY**

The name of the Society shall be "Sunrise Residency Welfare Association" (hereinafter referred to as "the Association").

**2. REGISTERED OFFICE**

The registered office of the Association shall be situated at No. 42, 5th Cross, Jakkasandra Extension, Koramangala 4th Block, Bengaluru – 560034, Karnataka, or at such other place in the city of Bengaluru as the General Body may decide from time to time.

**3. AIMS AND OBJECTS OF THE ASSOCIATION**

The aims and objects for which the Association is established are:

3.1 To promote the general welfare, safety, and security of the residents of Sunrise Residency.

3.2 To undertake, supervise, and manage the maintenance, repair, and upkeep of the common areas, including but not limited to:
   - The boundary walls and gates.
   - The internal roads, footpaths, and parking areas.
   - The clubhouse, gymnasium, and children's play area.
   - The garden, landscaped areas, and water bodies.
   - The sewage treatment plant and rainwater harvesting structures.

3.3 To install, operate, and maintain common utilities and services, including:
   - Lifts and elevators.
   - Water supply and borewell systems.
   - Electrical installations, including backup generators and common lighting.
   - Fire safety equipment and firefighting systems.
   - CCTV surveillance systems and security equipment.

The registration certificate of Sunrise Residency Welfare Association states that it is registered under the Karnataka Societies Registration Act, 1960. Record status: current.

3.4 To collect from the members such subscriptions, contributions, or charges as may be necessary for the purposes of the Association, and to administer and utilise such funds for the benefit of the residents.

3.5 To engage, employ, and supervise staff for the performance of the duties of the Association, including security personnel, maintenance staff, gardeners, and cleaning staff.

3.6 To enter into contracts and agreements with third-party service providers for the benefit of the Association.

3.7 To liaise with and represent the residents before the Bangalore Mahanagara Palike (now Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike), Bangalore Electricity Supply Company Limited, Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board, and other governmental or quasi-governmental authorities.

3.8 To undertake any other lawful activity that may be conducive to the welfare of the residents and the proper management of the residential complex.

**4. GOVERNING BODY**

4.1 The management of the Association shall be vested in a Governing Body, which shall consist of a President, a Vice-President, a Secretary, a Joint Secretary, a Treasurer, and not more than five (5) other members, all of whom shall be members of the Association.

4.2 The Governing Body shall be elected by the General Body of the members at the Annual General Meeting.

4.3 The term of office of the Governing Body shall be two (2) years, commencing from the date of election.

4.4 The Governing Body shall have the power to co-opt additional members, not exceeding three (3), who shall have the right to attend and vote at meetings of the Governing Body. Co-opted members shall hold office until the next Annual General Meeting.

**5. MEMBERSHIP**

5.1 Membership of the Association shall be open to all owners and legal occupants of residential units within Sunrise Residency.
5.2 Every member shall pay such admission fee and annual subscription as may be fixed by the Governing Body from time to time and approved by the General Body. The rates in force shall be communicated to all members by notice displayed on the notice board of the Association and circulated through the residents' email group.

5.3 A member shall be deemed to be in good standing if all dues, including maintenance charges, special levies, and other sums payable to the Association, have been paid in full up to the end of the immediately preceding month. A member not in good standing shall not be entitled to vote at any meeting of the General Body or to stand for election to the Governing Body.

5.4 Membership shall cease upon the transfer of the member's interest in the residential unit, upon written resignation, or upon expulsion by a resolution passed by two-thirds of the members present and voting at a General Body meeting convened for that purpose. The member concerned shall be given an opportunity to be heard before such expulsion.

5.5 The register of members shall be maintained by the Secretary and shall be open to inspection by any member at reasonable hours on prior written application.

**6. FINANCIAL YEAR AND ACCOUNTS**

6.1 The financial year of the Association shall commence on the first day of April of each year and shall end on the thirty-first day of March of the following year. All accounts, budgets, and financial statements of the Association shall be prepared and maintained with reference to such financial year. According to the bylaws, Sunrise Residency Welfare Association has fiscal year April 1 to March 31. Record status: current. The said financial year shall be the uniform accounting period for all purposes under these bylaws, including the preparation of the annual budget, the levy of maintenance charges, and the audit of accounts, unless the General Body, by a special resolution, determines otherwise for any particular purpose.

6.2 The Governing Body shall, not later than the fifteenth day of February in each financial year, cause to be prepared a budget of the estimated income and expenditure of the Association for the next ensuing financial year. The budget shall be placed before the General Body for approval at the Annual General Meeting. No expenditure of a capital nature exceeding fifty thousand rupees (Rs. 50,000) shall be incurred in any financial year unless provision therefor has been made in the budget approved by the General Body or unless the General Body subsequently sanctions such expenditure.

6.3 The Treasurer shall maintain, or cause to be maintained, proper books of account and records of all receipts and payments, assets and liabilities, and all other financial transactions of the Association. The books of account shall be kept at the registered office of the Association and shall be open to inspection by any member of the Governing Body at all reasonable times.

6.4 The Governing Body shall, within one hundred twenty (120) days of the close of each financial year, cause the accounts of the Association for that financial year to be audited by a chartered accountant or a firm of chartered accountants appointed by the General Body. The auditor so appointed shall not be a member of the Governing Body or an employee of the Association.

6.5 The audited statement of accounts, together with the auditor's report and the annual report of the Governing Body, shall be presented to the members at the Annual General Meeting convened for the consideration of the accounts for the relevant financial year. A copy of the audited statement of accounts shall be made available to every member at least seven (7) days before the date of such meeting.

7. GOVERNING BODY – COMPOSITION AND TENURE

7.1 The affairs of the Association shall be managed and administered by a Governing Body
consisting of not less than seven (7) and not more than eleven (11) members, all of whom shall be
members of the Association. The Governing Body shall be constituted from among the members of the
Association at the Annual General Meeting.

7.2 The office bearers of the Governing Body shall be a Chairman, a Vice-Chairman, a Secretary, a
Joint Secretary, a Treasurer, and such other office bearers as the Governing Body may decide from
time to time. The office bearers shall be elected by the Governing Body from amongst its own
members at its first meeting held after the Annual General Meeting.

7.3 The term of office of the members of the Governing Body shall be two (2) years from the date

office of Chairman for more than two (2) consecutive terms.

7.4 No person shall be eligible to be elected or appointed as a member of the Governing Body unless
such person is a member of the Association and has been residing in the premises of the
Association for a continuous period of not less than six (6) months immediately preceding the date
of nomination. A member who is in arrears of maintenance charges for a period exceeding three (3)
months shall not be eligible to contest or hold any office in the Governing Body.

shall be filled by the Governing Body by co-option from amongst the members of the Association. A
person so co-opted shall hold office for the unexpired term of the member whose vacancy is filled.

notice of each meeting, along with the agenda, at least seven (7) days prior to the date of the
meeting. The Chairman shall preside over the meetings of the Governing Body. In the absence of the
Chairman, the Vice-Chairman shall preside. In the absence of both, the members present may elect
one of their number to preside over that meeting.

**MEMORANDUM OF ASSOCIATION OF SUNRISE RESIDENCY WELFARE ASSOCIATION**

**1. NAME OF THE SOCIETY**

The name of the Society shall be "Sunrise Residency Welfare Association" (hereinafter referred to as "the Association").

**2. REGISTERED OFFICE**

The registered office of the Association shall be situated at No. 42, 5th Cross, Jakkasandra Extension, Koramangala 4th Block, Bengaluru – 560034, Karnataka, or at such other place in the city of Bengaluru as the General Body may decide from time to time.

**3. AIMS AND OBJECTS OF THE ASSOCIATION**

The aims and objects for which the Association is established are:

3.1 To promote the general welfare, safety, and security of the residents of Sunrise Residency.

3.2 To undertake, supervise, and manage the maintenance, repair, and upkeep of the common areas, including but not limited to:
   - The boundary walls and gates.
   - The internal roads, footpaths, and parking areas.
   - The clubhouse, gymnasium, and children's play area.
   - The garden, landscaped areas, and water bodies.
   - The sewage treatment plant and rainwater harvesting structures.

3.3 To install, operate, and maintain common utilities and services, including:
   - Lifts and elevators.
   - Water supply and borewell systems.
   - Electrical installations, including backup generators and common lighting.
   - Fire safety equipment and firefighting systems.
   - CCTV surveillance systems and security equipment.

The registration certificate of Sunrise Residency Welfare Association states that it is registered under the Karnataka Societies Registration Act, 1960. Record status: current.

3.4 To collect from the members such subscriptions, contributions, or charges as may be necessary for the purposes of the Association, and to administer and utilise such funds for the benefit of the residents.

3.5 To engage, employ, and supervise staff for the performance of the duties of the Association, including security personnel, maintenance staff, gardeners, and cleaning staff.

3.6 To enter into contracts and agreements with third-party service providers for the benefit of the Association.

3.7 To liaise with and represent the residents before the Bangalore Mahanagara Palike (now Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike), Bangalore Electricity Supply Company Limited, Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board, and other governmental or quasi-governmental authorities.

3.8 To undertake any other lawful activity that may be conducive to the welfare of the residents and the proper management of the residential complex.

**4. GOVERNING BODY**

4.1 The management of the Association shall be vested in a Governing Body, which shall consist of a President, a Vice-President, a Secretary, a Joint Secretary, a Treasurer, and not more than five (5) other members, all of whom shall be members of the Association.

4.2 The Governing Body shall be elected by the General Body of the members at the Annual General Meeting.

4.3 The term of office of the Governing Body shall be two (2) years, commencing from the date of election.

4.4 The Governing Body shall have the power to co-opt additional members, not exceeding three (3), who shall have the right to attend and vote at meetings of the Governing Body. Co-opted members shall hold office until the next Annual General Meeting.

**5. MEMBERSHIP**

5.1 Membership of the Association shall be open to all owners and legal occupants of residential units within Sunrise Residency.

**ITEM NO. 3 (CONTINUED): MAINTENANCE REPORT – LIFT MODERNISATION, BORE WELL RECHARGE PIT, AND COMMON AREA PAINTING**

The Maintenance Supervisor, Mr. D'Souza, continued his presentation covering the period November–December 2024.

**3.1 Lift Modernisation – Tower A and Tower B**

Mr. D'Souza reported that the lift modernisation work in Tower A and Tower B, undertaken by Apex Elevators, is progressing as per the approved schedule. The work commenced on 18th November 2024 and the estimated completion date is 15th January 2025. The following status was presented:

- **Tower A – Lift 1:** Controller replacement and new VVVF drive installation completed. Door operator mechanism replaced. The lift is currently operational in test mode, running approximately 8 hours per day for load testing and parameter tuning.
- **Tower A – Lift 2:** Work in progress. The old controller has been removed and the new controller cabinet is being wired. Expected completion by 25th December 2024.
- **Tower B – Lift 1:** New lift car interior panels and handrails installed. The LED lighting upgrade is pending. The car is not yet returned to service.
- **Tower B – Lift 2:** Work is scheduled to commence on 20th December 2024 after completion of Tower A – Lift 2.

Mr. Suresh Kumar from Apex Elevators clarified that one lift in each tower will be kept operational throughout the modernisation period to ensure minimal inconvenience to residents. The Committee appreciated the arrangement but noted that during the last week, there were complaints from residents of Tower B about a single lift being insufficient during morning peak hours. Mr. D'Souza informed that the second lift in Tower B is expected to be back in service by 22nd December 2024.

**Resolution No. 2024/12/04:** The Committee resolved to request Apex Elevators to deploy an additional technician on-site from 20th to 31st December 2024 to expedite the work and reduce the downtime of lifts in Tower B. The additional cost, if any, shall be borne from the approved modernisation contingency of ₹ 25,000. Proposed by Mr. Vikram Patel, seconded by Ms. Meera Krishnan. Passed unanimously.

**3.2 Bore Well Recharge Pit – Block C**

Mr. D'Souza reported that the bore well recharge pit near Block C has been excavated and the recharge shaft has been constructed. The inlet pipe from the terrace rainwater harvesting line has been connected to the pit. However, the following pending items were highlighted:

- The perforated casing pipe for the recharge shaft is yet to be installed. The supplier has promised delivery by 20th December 2024.
- The top slab for the pit has not been cast. The contractor has requested an extension due to the recent shortage of cement in the market.
- The filter media (gravel and sand) has been procured and is stored near the site.

1.1 Apex shall undertake the following services for the Association:
   a) Routine and preventive maintenance of all common area electrical installations, including but not limited to corridor lighting, lobby fixtures, lift motors and control panels, and backup generator systems.
   b) Plumbing and sanitation works, including repair of leaks, clearing of blockages in common drainage lines, and maintenance of the sewage treatment plant.
   c) Housekeeping services for common areas, including sweeping, mopping, and garbage collection from designated collection points.
   d) Maintenance of the lift system in working condition, with a response time of no more than 4 hours for reported breakdowns.

**4. OBLIGATIONS OF APEX**
